name: POWERGRID
h1: A record build programme needs one view of every project
lede: POWERGRID is carrying record capex into FY27 while winning new renewable evacuation schemes. Airtable gives project, procurement and commissioning teams one connected view of that portfolio.
why_h2: More projects, running in parallel, on tighter timelines
why_p: Record capex, a growing order book and new tariff-based wins all add workstreams that have to be tracked, coordinated and reported on at once.

signals.title: Record FY26 capex, Rs 37,000 crore guided for FY27
signals.body: FY26 capex reached Rs 39,967 crore, above the revised Rs 35,000 crore target and the highest in any fiscal year. Initial FY27 guidance is Rs 37,000 crore of capex and Rs 30,000 crore of capitalisation.
signals.angle: Capex and capitalisation targets at this scale depend on a live, shared view of every project's stage, owner and milestone.

signals.title: Insulated cross-arm monopoles cut right-of-way needs
signals.body: An insulated cross-arm monopole design reduced right-of-way requirements by about 20% on a 400kV line in FY26 and is planned for the Jhatikara-Dwarka 400kV line.
signals.angle: Rolling a proven design across more lines is a repeatable programme: track sites, approvals and lessons learnt in one place.

signals.title: Tumkur-II win to integrate 2.7 GW of renewables
signals.body: POWERGRID won a transmission project under tariff-based competitive bidding to integrate 2.7 GW of renewable energy in Karnataka.
signals.angle: Each TBCB win starts a new set of land, procurement and construction workstreams that need to be stood up quickly.

signals.title: 6 GW Barmer solar evacuation project awarded
signals.body: POWERGRID received a letter of intent on 2 September 2026 for an inter-state scheme to evacuate 6 GW of solar power from Rajasthan's Barmer complex, on a build, own, operate and transfer basis.
signals.angle: Large BOOT schemes run for decades: connect bid, build and operations data so nothing is re-keyed between phases.
